title: Lumped membrane heating: implicit-Euler time-step convergence (analytic)
description:
A thin silicon membrane (2D model of a 2 um layer, all in-plane faces insulated) heated uniformly by a heat_source Q and cooled through both faces by out_of_plane_convection (h * 2 / thickness). Every cell follows the same ODE rho cp dT/dt = Q - (2 h / t_z) (T - T_amb), so T stays uniform and conduction drops out: the run tests the time integration alone. Sweep over the steps per time constant n = tau / dt = 2..32.
Analytic: continuous theta = theta_ss (1 - exp(-t / tau)), theta_ss = Q t_z / (2 h) = 50 K, tau = rho cp t_z / (2 h) = 0.1 s; implicit Euler gives exactly theta_k = theta_ss (1 - (1 + dt / tau)^(-k)) at t = k dt, which lags the continuous curve by about theta_ss exp(-1) / (2 n) at t = tau (first order in dt).
Derived values tab: theta_tau (t = tau) and theta_end (t = 3 tau) against the discrete formula (exact to float32 storage, tolerance 1e-4), lag_tau = theta(tau) - theta_ss (1 - exp(-1)) against its discrete value (-0.29 K at n = 32 down to -3.8 K at n = 2; tolerance 1e-3).
Sweep tab: theta_tau with the discrete (dashed, toleranced) and continuous curves, lag_tau with the discrete curve and the first-order estimate -theta_ss exp(-1) / (2 n) (halves per doubling of n).
Probes tab (each sweep value): centre probe with the discrete curve (toleranced) and the continuous exponential.

parameters.name: cp_si
parameters.description: silicon specific heat in J/(kg K)

parameters.name: k_si
parameters.description: silicon thermal conductivity in W/(m K) (does not enter: T stays uniform)

parameters.name: t_z
parameters.description: membrane thickness the 2D model stands for

parameters.name: tau_th
parameters.description: thermal time constant rho cp t_z / (2 h) in s

parameters.name: h_conv
parameters.description: heat transfer coefficient of each face in W/(m^2 K) (16.3)

parameters.name: theta_ss
parameters.description: steady temperature rise Q t_z / (2 h) in K

parameters.name: T_amb
parameters.description: ambient and initial temperature in K

parameters.name: L_plate
parameters.description: side of the square membrane (10 x 10 cells)

parameters.name: theta_tau_ref
parameters.description: discrete rise at t = tau in K

parameters.name: theta_end_ref
parameters.description: discrete rise at t = 3 tau in K

parameters.name: lag_tau_ref
parameters.description: discrete minus continuous rise at t = tau in K (negative: the scheme lags)
